title: Genome-wide analysis identifies pleiotropic genes shared between severe mental disorders and biomarkers of cellular aging
title_zh: 全基因组分析揭示严重精神疾病与细胞衰老生物标志物共享的多效基因
abstract: Severe mental disorders such as bipolar disorder (BD), major depressive disorder (MDD) and schizophrenia (SZ) are characterized by reduced life expectancy, premature mortality and alterations of aging biomarkers, leading to hypothesize that they might be associated with accelerated cellular aging. We quantified the genetic overlap between severe mental disorders and a comprehensive set of aging biomarkers including multivariate longevity and healthy aging (mvAge), brain age gap (BAG), leucocyte telomere length (gLTL), mitochondrial DNA copy number and epigenetic age acceleration (gEAA) using cutting-edge methods, and evaluated their functional enrichment and suitability as drug targets. All disorders were negatively correlated with mvAge. Further, MDD correlated negatively with gLTL and positively with gEAA. We identified several pleiotropic variants, with nine genes (AC068490.2, ASIC2, CNNM2, FURIN, GPM6A, HS6ST3, RP5-1043L13.1, SORCS3 and SP4) containing variants shared between aging biomarkers and all disorders. Functional analyses with summary-data-based Mendelian randomization showed that increased expression of the druggable gene CRHR1 in the prefrontal cortex was associated with increased risk of MDD and BAG measures. Our findings suggest that shared heritability might contribute to reduced longevity and healthy aging in severe mental disorders and identify pleiotropic genes involved in synaptic function and metabolic processes related to micronutrients such as folate and magnesium.
abstract_zh: 严重精神疾病如双相情感障碍（BD）、重度抑郁障碍（MDD）和精神分裂症（SZ）表现为寿命缩短、早逝和衰老生物标志物的改变，提示它们可能与细胞衰老加速相关。我们利用尖端方法量化了严重精神疾病与一系列衰老生物标志物（包括多变量寿命与健康衰老指数 mvAge、脑龄差距 BAG、白细胞端粒长度 gLTL、线粒体 DNA 复制数和表观遗传年龄加速 gEAA）之间的遗传重叠，并评估其功能富集及作为药物靶点的适用性。所有疾病均与 mvAge 负相关。进一步地，MDD 与 gLTL 负相关，与 gEAA 正相关。我们鉴定了若干多效变异，其中九个基因（AC068490.2、ASIC2、CNNM2、FURIN、GPM6A、HS6ST3、RP5-1043L13.1、SORCS3 和 SP4）在衰老生物标志物与所有疾病之间共享变异。基于汇总数据的孟德尔随机化功能分析显示，前额叶皮层中可药物化基因 CRHR1 的表达升高与 MDD 风险和 BAG 测量的升高相关。我们的发现表明，共享的遗传性可能导致严重精神疾病中寿命和健康衰老的降低，并识别了涉及突触功能和与叶酸、镁等微量营养素相关的代谢过程的多效基因。
